newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: NEW CZECH, SLOVAK PHONE CODES ON MARCH 1.
newsitem.headline: NEW CZECH, SLOVAK PHONE CODES ON MARCH 1.

text.p: The international country code for dialling the Czech Republic will be changed to +420 as of March 1, and Slovakia's code will be +421, the Czech telephone monopoly SPT Telecom a.s. said on Thursday.
The firm said in a statement that the change, decided by the International Telecommunications Union, reflected the split of former Czechoslovakia in 1993.
It said that the split in codes would help in payment settlement for incoming international calls as well. The current code common for both countries, +42, will not be in operation after March 1.
